candidates.formal_type:
∀ (q : Units.{0} Complex) (V : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
  [inst_2 : Module.{0, u_1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.Uqsl2 q) V]
  [IsScalarTower.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.Uqsl2 q) V] [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} Complex V],
  Not (IsOfFinOrder.{0} q) →
    ∀ [Nontrivial.{u_1} V],
      Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun v =>
        Exists.{1} fun lam =>
          And (Ne.{u_1 + 1} v 0)
            (And (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.e q) v) 0)
              (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.K q) v)
                (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} lam v)))
